name: QikChat Instant Booking
author: seb447788

sections.description:
QikChat captures a lead, routes it to the right salesperson by round robin, and emails the lead a link to that person’s available times. This plugin is how the forms on your site feed it.

It does not add another form builder. It connects to the form plugin you already use and sends each submission to QikChat server side, leaving your form’s own confirmation exactly as it is.

Supported form plugins

  • Gravity Forms
  • WPForms
  • Elementor Pro Forms
  • Contact Form 7
  • Fluent Forms

Sites with no form plugin can use the built in [qikchat_lead_form] shortcode, which collects only the fields QikChat stores.

What it does

  • One click connect, so there is no webhook url to copy or token to paste
  • Detects your existing forms and guesses the field mapping for you
  • Leaves each form’s own confirmation alone, so nothing on your site changes for the visitor
  • Checks the connection twice a day and warns in the admin if captures stop working
  • Keeps a log of what was sent and what came back

External services

This plugin connects to QikChat (app.qik-chat.com), a lead routing and meeting scheduling service. QikChat creates the lead, assigns it to a salesperson and emails the lead a link to that person’s available times. The plugin does nothing without a QikChat account.

The plugin sends data to QikChat in these cases.

  • Connecting. When an administrator chooses Sign in with QikChat, the browser goes to QikChat with the site’s address and name. Once the administrator approves the connection, the plugin exchanges a one time code for a webhook token, server to server.
  • Form submissions. When a visitor submits a form you switched on, or the [qikchat_lead_form] shortcode form, the plugin sends the mapped fields to QikChat. These are first name, last name, email, phone, company and job title, plus the page address and the site’s timezone. Forms you have not switched on send nothing.
  • Connection checks. Twice a day, and when you run a check on the Test tab, the plugin sends QikChat a test call that contains no visitor data.
  • Test leads. The Test tab sends one lead with the email address you enter.

Every request also carries the site’s home address in its User-Agent header.

QikChat terms of service and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to QikChat in the admin menu and choose Sign in with QikChat.
  3. Pick the team and integration this site should feed.
  4. On the Forms tab, switch on the forms you want sent and check the field mapping.
  5. On the Test tab, run a connection check.
sections.faq:
Does this replace my form plugin?

No. It reads the forms you already have and sends their submissions on.

Where is my webhook token stored?

In the WordPress options table, and it is only ever used server side. It is never printed into a page or sent to the browser.

What happens if the connection breaks?

Captures are logged as failures, the admin shows a warning, and the twice daily check reports the reason. Submissions still save in your form plugin as normal, so nothing is lost.
sections.changelog:
0.5.6

  • Returning from QikChat during connect now checks a WordPress nonce, carried inside the state value, so the return is tied to the administrator who started it.
  • Redirects to QikChat go through wp_safe_redirect, with the QikChat host allowed only for that redirect.
  • Admin ajax handlers check their nonce before reading the request, and posted field mappings are sanitized before use.
  • Log table queries use identifier placeholders instead of putting the table name in the SQL.

0.5.5

  • Added an External services section to this readme covering what is sent to QikChat and when.
  • The admin menu icon style now loads through the WordPress style queue.
  • Removed the browser redirect fallback for WPForms builds older than 1.9.8.6.
  • Translations now load the way WordPress.org loads them, so the plugin no longer loads its own.

0.5.4

  • Removed the post submit choice from the form settings. QikChat does not return a booking link when it captures a lead, so sending the visitor to the booking page or embedding it could not work, and every form now plainly says the lead is emailed a link to their salesperson’s times.
  • A form previously set to redirect or embed no longer does either, so nothing can start redirecting on its own later.

0.5.3

  • All three post submit choices stay selectable while instant booking is unavailable, so picking the scheduling email is no longer a one way door, with a line under them saying what happens in the meantime.

0.5.2

  • The QikChat admin menu icon now sits level with its label, matching the other menu items.

0.5.1

  • Signing in now stops at a QikChat page that shows which site is asking to connect, and the team leader approves it before anything is exchanged.
  • The plugin no longer stores empty credential fields the connect response never contained.

0.5.0

  • Removed connecting by pasting a webhook token, signing in with QikChat is the only connect path now.
  • A development site can point at another QikChat address by defining QIKCHAT_IB_API_BASE in wp-config.php.
  • The connect screen says only the team leader can connect the site.

0.4.1

  • The admin menu icon is now the 20 pixel size WordPress expects, and its url carries the plugin version so browsers do not keep showing an old copy.

0.4.0

  • Sign in with QikChat now works against the QikChat sign in flow, one click, no token to paste.
  • The QikChat menu in the admin uses the QikChat icon.
  • Connection errors from QikChat now show QikChat’s own explanation.

0.3.0

  • Fixed the moment of capture for Gravity Forms so redirect and inline work there.
  • Fixed redirects for WPForms forms whose own confirmation is a message.
  • Fixed the Fluent Forms confirmation hook, the previous one ignored the changes.
  • Fixed Elementor submissions being skipped because of a mismatched form key.
  • Fixed the Elementor inline embed listener, the event is a jQuery event.

0.2.0

  • Added connecting by pasting a webhook token, for use until the sign in flow exists in QikChat.

0.1.0

  • First draft.
